name: open-design-points
body: Open design points for the plan (do NOT invent decisions here): (1) per-language granularity — package vs module vs crate — and what "signature" means for early cutoff; (2) where the shared content-addressed fact store lives and how worktrees/DBs project from it; (3) the DB splice mechanism (seed-from-previous vs overlay) and its atomicity; (4) re-anchor/fallback thresholds — purely correctness/version gates, never heuristics.
